report: Source assessment: the complete claim requires retaining identity, input and state as distinct declared field kinds. The sole ordinary implementation association in parser.rs is supported by the full captured parser: document consumes the three keywords into FieldKind::Identity, ::Input and ::State respectively and stores that kind unchanged in Field and its enclosing class/context. This is a metadata distinction, not a promise of executable mutation or interning. The sole ordinary annotated test, fields_preserve_identity_input_and_state_kinds, parses identity and input fields in Item and a state field in Work; its three visible equality assertions independently check each retained variant and would detect collapsing or exchanging kinds. Captured parse/valid/class helpers construct the document, check validation errors, and select the named declaration; they do not hide the meaningful assertions. No TODO/N/A entries or deferred prerequisites exist. Baseline: independently compared current parser.rs and envelopes.rs against the historical implementation_sources and test_sources; both are exact byte matches. Reassessed the supplied historical rationale against the current complete claim, association set and assertions; it remains sufficient. Execution: personally ran review start/read and byte comparisons; no behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator-reported 321 passing functional tests and cargo build are separate execution evidence. No edits required.
